description: Add an intellectual-property claim to your Life and Work resume, including the hash of your IP file. Writes to the chain: this prepares an unsigned transaction (an intent) for `signer`; nothing happens until you sign it with geode-local-signer and submit it with geode_submit_intent.

keywords_or_description.description: UTF-8 text, at most 2048 bytes; no control or invisible characters

signer.description: Your account address (SS58). The transaction is prepared for this account; you sign it on your own machine with geode-local-signer.

url_link_to_see_more.description: https:// URL or empty string, at most 512 bytes

name: geode_lifeandwork_make_claim_intellectualproperty
